Scholarship overview

Harding scholarships support doctoral research across Cambridge. Applicants are considered through their course and funding application; the current award-year terms should be checked.

Research Areas

  • Eligible subjects across the university

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
FundingHome/Overseas fees and maintenance; published scheme information includes visa/IHS and a research allowance up to GBP 6,000.
MaintenanceMaintenance grant; current amount not confirmed
DurationCourse length; fourth-year maintenance may require approval

Eligibility and Requirements

PhD applicants from any country and discipline, subject to academic selection and scheme college conditions. English evidence, approved equivalents and waivers depend on the programme; IELTS is not a universal requirement for every applicant.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
RecruitmentScheme confirmed; award-year terms require confirmation
DeadlineYour Cambridge course funding deadline; current award terms must be confirmed

How to Apply

Submit your Cambridge PhD and funding application by the course deadline, following the Harding application guidance.

The supplied funding-search record is for 2025/26. The current programme application page is available, but do not reuse old award-year amounts as 2027 guarantees.

About University of Cambridge

The University of Cambridge offers research degrees across a wide range of subjects. Doctoral applicants apply through its postgraduate portal and may be considered for university, college and partner funding.
